Name: Crop Growth Adjustments
Author: gzhynko
Description:
[b]Crop Growth Adjustments[/b] [b](CGA)[/b] allows you to adjust crop growth parameters through content packs. These adjustments are applied to one crop at a time and include the following:
[list]
[*]Change seasons crops grow in
[*]Change seasons crops produce in
[*]Add special sprites for certain seasons (example: grape vine covered in snow during winter).
[/list]
Adjustments are added in the form of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Content_packs]content packs[/url]. I am working on making a full guide on the format for the content packs, but for a quick overview of CGA's content pack format see the [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/stardew-mods/tree/master/CropGrowthAdjustments/examples]examples folder[/url] or my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7759]Grapes All Year Round[/url] mod﻿. Note: a single content pack may include multiple adjustments.


[size=4]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip its folder into your Mods folder.
[*]Install any of the existing adjustment packs or create your own and put them into your Mods folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4]Compatibility
[/size][list]
[*]Compatible with SMAPI 3.18 and higher (the latest version is recommended).
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 and higher.
[/list]

Crop Growth Adjustments is [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/StardewMods/tree/master/CropGrowthAdjustments]open-source[/url]﻿ and is licensed under the [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/StardewMods/blob/master/LICENSE]0BSD License[/url]﻿.
